headline: The housing market appears to have lost momentum, with a noticeable price decline already visible here
summary: Average advertised prices per square metre fell in October in 12 districts of Budapest, suggesting the housing market has lost momentum.
why: Property prices influence household wealth, mortgage credit demand and the broader Hungarian economy.
